items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: Cab Calloway, Sweetheart of the Rhythm

ctx.x: Lewis, Count Faison, Buddy Johnson, Cab Calloway, Sweetheart of the Rhythm, the Rhythm band. Now all the other ones, like, went up to Country and Made Good, Johnny Jots, Kid Ora's, George bamboo I had a band going there. I lived in Oakland. Musicians down here. In the circuit. Punch. Chris Kelly. Keita Renee. Buddy Pettine.
They all stayed in New Orleans.
